desc: Colorful, multilevel shopping mall with a domed glass roof, bowling alley & movie theater.
addr: Park square Mall , ITPB main road , international tech park, Whitefield Main Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India

rev.t: Compact mall with good connectivity with ITPl, metro and road. Ground and top floor contain most of the food and beverage stall. Most part of the mall were under renovation when visited. There are few shopping stalls such as zudio, easy buy …

This mall is just after ITPL. It’s on the main and the access is easy. It is next to Pattandur Agrahara metro station. The mall is not too crowded and has a large basement parking area. Overall it is maintained well. There are some well known outlets like Zudio, Braque nation , Harddock cafe etc. plus there is multiplex also

Kids went for movie n bowling enjoyed thier friends birthday party 😉.  We had visited the shops too.  Easy buy is a good choice for women wear with variety of options with affordable price. We can find options for kids too. Variety of food options along with PVR. A quiet mall to roam and spent time . We hav parking lot too …
